shared_or_similar_visual_information: A filled or hatched subregion of a larger polygon
mathematical_meanings: Left image: A selected geometric subregion whose plane area is distinguished from the unhatched parts. Right image: A selected geometric subregion whose plane area is distinguished from the other rectangular part.
Rationales: The fill separates a particular geometric area from neighboring unfilled or differently filled areas in both constructions. It is a region-selection cue rather than an angle annotation.
